description.text:
Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies in GMP

September 30, 2026 | 2:00 PM GMT

The pharmaceutical and life sciences industry is entering a new era, one where Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies are reshaping how Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) is understood, implemented, and audited.

Join us for an insightful session exploring how AI, machine learning, automation, and digital tools are transforming quality assurance, manufacturing processes, compliance monitoring, and regulatory readiness within GMP environments.

What we'll cover:
The role of AI in predictive quality control and deviation management
How emerging technologies are streamlining GMP compliance and documentation
Opportunities and challenges of AI adoption in regulated manufacturing
Regulatory perspectives on AI-driven validation and data integrity
Real-world applications and future trends shaping the industry

Whether you're a quality professional, regulatory affairs specialist, manufacturing leader, or simply curious about where GMP is headed in the age of AI; this session is for you.

Format: LinkedIn Live
Date: September 30, 2026
Time: 2:00 PM GMT

Save your spot and be part of the conversation shaping the future of GMP!

#GMP #ArtificialIntelligence #PharmaTech #QualityAssurance #LifeSciences #EmergingTechnology #PharmaceuticalManufacturing #DigitalTransformation #Compliance
